name: Loading Room
summary: In Gnomeregan's depths, the Loading Room lies amid danger. It once staged cargo for the city's transit networks. Now radioactive fallout and rogue machinery threaten all who enter.

sections.title: Industrial Depot Under Siege
sections.body:
Cargo once passed through the Loading Room on its way across Gnomeregan's underground transit network. Goods gathered in its staging bay before the trains carried them through the tinker capital.

Now ruin has overtaken the chamber. Radioactive fallout, invading troggs, and failing machinery make it perilous. Techbot, a rogue mechanized construct, guards the vicinity. Gnome survivors and Alliance reclaimers who try to secure the perimeter must face that danger.

faq.q: What is the Loading Room used for?
faq.answer: The Loading Room once staged cargo for Gnomeregan's internal transport and train facilities. Since the city fell, hazards have overrun this lost sector.

faq.q: What threats can be found in the Loading Room?
faq.answer: Techbot, a rogue mechanical defense construct, prowls the Loading Room. Radioactive contamination and erratic machinery threaten anyone in this part of the city.

faq.q: Is the Loading Room safe to explore?
faq.answer: No. The Loading Room lies in contested ground among Gnomeregan's ruins. Alliance strike teams entering the complex face hostile constructs and toxic conditions.

angles.text: For gnomish reclaimers, the Loading Room recalls how ordinary city works were abandoned during the trogg invasion and toxic catastrophe.
Techbot and the remaining mechanical assemblies in the Loading Room show engineers the danger of automated defenses left without maintenance.
